details: Both files are OpenML 1107 (tumors_C, Pomeroy et al. 2002). Identical SHA-256: 0e449bf5... Corrupts benchmark by counting CNS twice.
61 of 72 Golub 1999 leukemia patients are embedded directly in Ramaswamy GCM (OpenML 1106). Reusing both in benchmark violates patient independence.
8 Pomeroy 2002 medulloblastoma samples are embedded directly in Ramaswamy GCM.
e1_extended_benchmarks.py fetched OpenML 1106 (GCM) and misnamed it 'lung_cancer'. It is the 14-tumor GCM dataset.
e1_extended_benchmarks.py fetched OpenML 1157 (AP_Endometrium_Kidney) and misnamed it 'lymphoma'.
e1_extended_benchmarks.py fetched OpenML 1120 (MagicTelescope astrophysics, D=10) and mislabeled it 'breast_cancer_genomic'. Zero biological validity.
e1_extended_benchmarks.py fetched OpenML 41027 (Jungle Chess endgame, D=6) and mislabeled it 'gisette'.
e1_extended_benchmarks.py fetched OpenML 554 (MNIST 784 pixels) and mislabeled it 'usps' (which is 256 pixels).
Both refer to the exact same 700-cell subsample from 10x Genomics Donor A distributed via scanpy.datasets.pbmc68k_reduced.
Su AI et al. (GNF / Novartis Research Foundation). While samples represent distinct tumor panels, both share microarray processing protocols and platform.
Leukemia-3 uses the same underlying Hu6800 ALL/AML cohorts with explicit 3-class biological subtyping (ALL-B, ALL-T, AML).
